claim: Staff training alone can reduce a restaurant's electricity use by 30 percent.

evidence.title: Operational energy training case report
evidence.text: A small hospitality pilot observed lower electricity use after staff training, but equipment changes and seasonal demand were not controlled.

evidence.title: Restaurant electricity intervention study
evidence.text: The study found that combined maintenance, controls and staff engagement reduced electricity demand. It did not isolate a 30 percent effect from training alone.

evidence.title: Unverified social media post
evidence.text: A restaurant manager says training always cuts electricity by at least 30 percent.

reviews.rationale: The percentage and the word alone are not supported.
Training may help but the size of the effect is unclear.
The strongest evidence describes a combined intervention.
